open_evidence.sm222_publication: Existing Reson SeaBat 7150 MBES coverage off Pudimadaka-Narsapuram: 18,000 km2, 5,245 line-km, 21 coast-parallel transects, 80% overlap; exact target intersection still not promoted without machine-readable geometry.
